label: Master Chief
description: Terse, unshakeable, and treating the school run as a combat drop.
direction: Speak low, calm and gravelly, with clipped military economy. No wasted words, no raised voice, dry understatement. Keep the direction word crisp.
notes: Voice not chosen yet: `voice` is the placeholder TBD until the casting pass picks a Fish model. The Chief says very little, so the lines are short and the humour is understatement. Catchphrases sit on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.author: Microsoft / Halo Studios (character created at Bungie)
rights.pd_basis: None. Microsoft holds copyright and trademark in the character. Steve Downes has voiced Master Chief in the games since 2001 and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Steve Downes's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Hold course.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Stay on mission.
lines.start_drive_1: Spartan one one seven, ready. Let's move.
lines.start_drive_2: I need a weapon. And a destination. Got one. Go.
lines.start_drive_3: Cortana plotted the route. I'll call it out.
lines.start_drive_5: Warthog's fueled. You drive, I'll navigate.
lines.start_drive_6: Wake me when you need me. Never mind. I'm up.
lines.start_drive_7: Mission is a go. Stay sharp.
lines.start_drive_8: Buckle up. I've crash landed enough for both of us.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Change of plans.
lines.arrived: We've arrived. Mission complete. Wake me when you need me.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Roger that.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Stay sharp.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Almost as big as a Halo ring.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. I've fought through worse.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Somebody flipped the Warthog again.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Eyes up, Spartan.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down. That's an order.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Hold position.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Friendlies. Keep it legal.
lines.reroute_chime: Missed it. Thought I'd try another way. New route.
